title: Write a Content Part With a Display Driver | Orchard Core
description:
A content part adds data, an editor, and a display to the content items of a type. Writing one means knowing the pieces Orchard Core expects: a class, a display driver, templates, and a registration.

This video goes through the Title part of Orchard Core piece by piece, then adds the part to a content type, edits an item, and displays it on the site.

In this video:
• The pieces of a part
• The class, its view model, and its definition
• The display driver: Display, Edit, and UpdateAsync
• The templates of each shape
• Registering the part
• Adding the part to a content type
• Editing and displaying the part
• Settings, handlers, placement, and alternates
